title: Stool culture for Salmonella and Shigella
also: stool test for a work health certificate
what: This is a stool test. The lab grows germs from it to find dangerous gut bacteria and choose a medicine that works.
why: For diarrhea with fever, blood, or mucus. It is also required for the work health record of kitchen and childcare staff.
duration: collection takes a few minutes; results usually come in 3 to 5 days
tell_doctor: If you took antibiotics in the past few weeks
If there is blood or mucus in the stool
If anyone close to you was sick
If you need the test for work or a health record

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a sterile container from a pharmacy or the lab. For stool, choose one with a small spoon in the lid.

prepare.title: Antibiotics
prepare.text: It is better to do the test before starting antibiotics. If you already take them, do not stop on your own. Tell your doctor.

prepare.title: Collection
prepare.text: Collect stool from a clean surface, not from the toilet. Laxatives and suppositories are usually not used before collection. Ask your doctor.

prepare.title: Delivery
prepare.text: Fresh stool must get to the lab quickly, usually within a couple of hours. The lab will tell you the exact time.

steps: Line the toilet or potty with clean plastic wrap or paper
Use the spoon in the lid to take a bit of stool, ideally with mucus if there is any
Put it in the container and close it tightly
Wash your hands and take it to the lab right away
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a normal stool sample
The main thing is not to delay getting it to the lab
after: With diarrhea, drink often, in small sips
If a germ is found, the lab will show which medicines work against it
red_flags: Blood in the stool, high fever, or severe belly pain: see a doctor the same day
Signs of dehydration, like a dry mouth, little urine, or severe weakness: see a doctor urgently
Fainting or confusion: call emergency services

faq.q: Why do results take so long?
faq.a: The germs first have to grow in the lab. That takes several days.

faq.q: Can I collect stool in the evening and bring it in the morning?
faq.a: Fresh stool is usually needed. If there is no other way, ask the lab how to store it.

reminders.text: Stool culture tomorrow. Have a sterile container ready, and take the stool to the lab soon after collecting it.
